headline: CF Montréal beaten 4–0 at Charlotte
detail: Liel Abada scored a hat-trick (67', 79', 83') after Idan Toklomati's early opener as Charlotte beat CF Montréal 4–0. Alexis Sánchez came off the bench at 63'.

headline: Davies scores and assists in 6–1 Pokal win
detail: Alphonso Davies came on at half-time, won the penalty for Olise's second, scored Bayern's fourth (70') and set up Nathaniel Brown (73') as Bayern beat Magdeburg 6–1 to reach the DFB-Pokal last 16.

headline: Johnston out until after the break
detail: Celtic manager Martin O'Neill said Alistair Johnston's new hamstring problem is not the same injury and should be shorter, but he can't see him playing before the mid-November international break. That puts Canada's Nations League quarter-final against Guatemala in doubt.

headline: Oluwaseyi scores as Villarreal win 5–0
detail: Tani Oluwaseyi started and scored Villarreal's second goal (26') in a 5–0 Copa del Rey first-round win at fifth-tier CE Manacor. Tajon Buchanan stayed on the bench; Nathan Saliba is still injured.

headline: Davies' teammate Kane wins the Ballon d'Or
detail: Alphonso Davies' Bayern Munich teammate Harry Kane won the 2026 Ballon d'Or and the Gerd Müller Trophy. Alexia Putellas won the women's award.

headline: Johnston forced off on Celtic return
detail: Alistair Johnston came on at 52' for his first game since August, then went off at 73' with a hamstring problem in Celtic's 2–1 win at Hibernian. Martin O'Neill said the severity isn't known yet; Canada play Guatemala in the Nations League quarter-final in November.

headline: Davies' Bayern win 3–1 at Freiburg
detail: Alphonso Davies came off the bench late on as Bayern won without the ill Vincent Kompany (Upamecano, Gnabry, Olise; Bischof own goal).

headline: Colyn scores vs Midtjylland
detail: Simon Colyn scored in the 32nd minute, his fifth league goal of the season, but Lyngby lost 3–2.

headline: Sonis: two assists in 6–1 rout
detail: Janine Sonis set up two goals in Denver Summit's 6–1 win over Racing Louisville, in her 150th NWSL appearance. She has 12 goals and 8 assists this season.

headline: Cavalry win the CPL Shield
detail: Ali Musse's 29th-minute goal beat Vancouver FC 1–0 at ATCO Field on the final day. Cavalry finish two points clear of Forge; Vancouver FC miss the playoffs.

headline: Greco-Taylor plays 90 as Pacific hold Forge
detail: TNB partner Christian Greco-Taylor played the full match in Pacific's 1–1 draw with Forge (Borges 12', Kratt 72'); Sami Keshavarz came off the bench late. Forge finish 2nd and meet Atlético Ottawa in the semi-finals (1 and 7 Nov).

headline: Supra edge HFX 4–3 to make the playoffs
detail: Ibrahim Condé scored twice and Sean Rea hit the 71st-minute winner in Halifax. FC Supra take the last playoff place in their first season and face Cavalry; Loïc Kwemi wins the Golden Boot with 15.

headline: Inter Toronto beat Ottawa 2–1
detail: Ariel Almagro (36') and Julian Altobelli (90') scored; Nicolas Fleuriau Chateau's stoppage-time penalty was Ottawa's reply. Ottawa finish 3rd.

headline: Whitecaps lose 1–0 at Colorado
detail: Morgan Whittaker headed in an 81st-minute rebound off the crossbar. Emmanuel Sabbi went off injured after 27 minutes and Yadaly Diaby at half-time. Vancouver stay top of the West on 55 points, one ahead of FC Dallas, with three games left.

headline: Saliba misses Valencia derby
detail: Nathan Saliba sat out Villarreal's 2–1 win over Valencia with a muscle injury; return date not given. Tajon Buchanan started and played 87 minutes.

headline: Toronto FC lose 4–2 at Columbus
detail: Columbus led 3–0 by the 48th minute (Tapia, Amundsen x2, then Lennon). Sallói (69') and Sargent (81') pulled two back. Richie Laryea started on his return from suspension.

headline: CF Montréal out of the playoff race
detail: A 2–0 home loss to MLS-leading Nashville SC (Surridge 52', Mukhtar) at Stade Saputo officially ends Montréal's playoff hopes. They sit 6-18-7.

headline: Montreal Roses win the Supporters' Shield
detail: Tanya Boychuk's late winner, set up by Marie-Yasmine Alidou, beat Ottawa Rapid 1–0 at Stade Boréale. Montreal finish top of the NSL on 45 points: the club's first trophy.

headline: Forge FC are Canadian Champions
detail: 1–1 at Stade Saputo, then 4–2 on penalties vs CF Montréal. The first CPL club ever to win it, and a 2027 CONCACAF Champions Cup place. TNB partners Tavernier and Bruno are in the squad.

headline: Davies scores vs Arsenal
detail: Alphonso Davies equalised in the 35th minute, set up by Harry Kane, in Bayern's 2–2 Champions League draw. His second UCL goal this season.

headline: Badwal named Best Young Player
detail: Vancouver Whitecaps' Jeevan Badwal picked up the 2026 Canadian Championship's Best Young Player award.

headline: Oluwaseyi scores at Anfield
detail: Tani Oluwaseyi scored, assisted by Nathan Saliba, in Villarreal's 4–3 Champions League loss at Liverpool. Tajon Buchanan also played on his return from injury.

headline: Millar brace vs QPR
detail: Liam Millar scored twice in 71 minutes as Birmingham beat QPR 3–0. Three goals in two games.

headline: Larin off injured vs Bolton
detail: Cyle Larin left Southampton's 0–0 draw with Bolton in the 41st minute with a muscle problem. Return date unknown.

headline: Olguin's first pro goal
detail: TNB partner Lucas Olguin equalised in the 44th minute at Vancouver FC. HFX went on to lose 2–1.

headline: Oluwaseyi scores at Napoli
detail: Off the bench to score in Villarreal's 3–1 Champions League win in Naples.
